title.en: Byoujaku na Imouto ni Subete wo Sakushusarete Kita Reijou wa Mou Nani mo Ubawasenai
Shukujo no Kagami Yamemashita. Toki wo Gyakkou shita Koushaku Reijou wa, Wagamama na Imouto ni Furimawasarenai you Seikaku Waruku Ikinobimasu!
Akuyaku Reijou wa Mou Zenbu ga Iya ni Natta no de, Kioku Soushitsu no Furi wo suru Koto ni shita
Enzai Reijou wa Shinjitai - Ginpatsu ga Fukitsu to Iwarete Konyaku Hakisareta Shishaku Reijou wa Ansatsu Kizoku ni Dekiaisarete Daini no Jinsei wo Tannou suru you desu
Binbou Kishi ni Yomeiri Shita Hazu ga!? Yajin Reijou wa Koutaishihi ni Natte mo Ryuu wo Karitai
Watashi wa Teki ni narimasen! - Aku no Majutsushi ni Tensei shitakedo, Shinu no wa Gomen na no de Scenario ni Sakaratte Ikinobimasu
Konyaku haki sareta muhyoujou reijou ga shiawase ni naru made ~Kinmusaki no tennen tarashi kishidan-chou-sama ga torottoro ni amayakashite dekiai shite kuru no desu ga!?~
Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni narimashita ~Watashi wo Akujo da to Gokai shiteita no ni, Subete Gibo no Uso da to Kizuita you desu~
Koi ni Koisuru Koushaku Reijou no Kojirase Renai
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
Akuyaku Reijou wa Boukensha ni Naru Tame Konyaku Haki wo Nozomimasu
Ochikobore Reijou wa, Koushaku Kakka kara no Dekiai ni Kizukanai ~Konyakusha ni Shimeisareta no wa Saishoku Kenbi no Ane de wa Naku, Watashi deshita~
Kanpeki Sugiru ga Kosando mo Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa Ringoku no Outaishi to Musubareru?!
Meryoku no nai Otaku Reijou wa, Jiki Koushaku-sama no Ichizu na Dekiai ni Honrousareru
Uchi no Outaishi Denka wa Kyou mo Gu Kawaii ~Konyaku Haki desu no? Mochiron Kyakkashimasu keredo, Riyuu wa Kiite Sashiagemasu wa~
Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu! - Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?
Doumo, Akuyaku ni Sareta Reijou desukeredo
